title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursement Limit for High-Deductible Plans
content:
**Schedule.** The Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply, under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, starts from the patient's plan and fill cadence:

| Linked coverage (Prescription Insurance on File) | Refills of the card's prescription dated fewer than 12 whole months before today | Reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | 10 or more | $1000.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | 6 to 9 | $900.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | 5 or fewer | the program's per-fill benefit maximum |
| Any other plan | any number | the program's per-fill benefit maximum |

**Readings.** The plan is the class of the coverage record the card is linked to under Prescription Insurance on File. The refills are the refill entries of the card's prescription on the Prescriptions fill ledger dated fewer than 12 whole months before today; a refill dated exactly 12 whole months before today is outside the count.

**Hypothetical patients.**

- Linked to a Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan with 10 refills in the window: $1000.00.
- Same plan with 9 refills: $900.00.
- Linked to a Commercial Copay Plan with 12 refills: the program's per-fill benefit maximum.
